title: Egg Drop Irish Bacon Toast
description: A Whole30-friendly breakfast dish featuring crusty bread, crispy bacon, and a resinous glaze.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit (200 degrees Celsius).
Cook the Irish bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Set aside.
In the same skillet, combine the honey, apple cider vinegar, and black pepper. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and carefully crack in the eggs. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the eggs are cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the bread in the oven until crispy.
To assemble the dish, place a toasted bread slice on a plate, then top with a slice of crispy bacon, a spoonful of the egg mixture, and another slice of toasted bread.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a slice of toasted bread on top.
